main_body: A small wooden cradle with a tall hood at the left, a white pillow, a blue blanket on the right and rockers underneath, drawn from the side
top_band: At x=11, light blue blanket on rows 7-9 under a dark outline on rows 5-6. At x=8 there is no top band, only dark rows 3-8 (hood interior). At x=4, a cream rim and pillow on rows 3-9.
evidence: The cradle reads as an end-on profile: a tall hood on the left, a low basin to the right, and rockers below. The blanket and pillow are the only light areas and are painted as flat side-view shapes rather than a foreshortened horizontal surface above a south face. The basin wall is only 2 brown rows (10-11) and no rim or front-edge line closes a top surface. The 3 blue rows are the contents seen from the side, not a top. This matches the red side-elevation chair in the guide, so it fails.

style.evidence: The measured facts put the candidate at 19 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, with 0% flat-fill coverage and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so the outlines are tinted brown. The wood has a cream highlight, mid and dark ramp, and the pillow and blanket have their own light-to-shadow steps. For its size the piece is as dense as the references and does not look like a sticker next to them.
